spine.note: A constructed year through Newman’s Parochial and Plain Sermons, eight volumes, 191 sermons (Rivingtons 1868 and Longmans reprints; vols VII–VIII from Project Gutenberg). Overflow sits in the index. The Apologia, the Idea of a University, the Grammar of Assent, and the Essay on Development sit on the Works shelf, not on the calendar. 366 readings through the year. 1553 further readings sit in the index, not on the calendar.
